name: Verified Download Control & Active Continuity
changes: Failed/Completed SAB-backed Remove now retries transient Queue/History reads and treats terminal SAB history as safe proof that a transfer has already stopped when Queue itself is briefly unreadable.
Expected verified Remove/Cancel failures are surfaced with their real reason instead of the generic Unexpected application error response.
Successful Remove/Cancel clears the cached pre-mutation SAB snapshot so a transient immediate refresh cannot resurrect the deleted Failed card.
Package Remove/Cancel buttons show an in-progress state and reject duplicate clicks while verified deletion is running.
NewzDeck's own Pause/Resume intent is authoritative for immediate presentation; a transient SAB aggregate Paused sample cannot immediately empty a previously proven Active queue.
A coherent Active snapshot is held for up to 12 seconds when SAB unexpectedly reports global Paused while NewzDeck knows the user did not pause the queue.

The SAB background coordinator reasserts Resume after an unexpected transient pause; a genuine user Pause still takes effect immediately and a persistent SAB pause becomes visible after the bounded grace.
SAB adapter telemetry and runtime identity now match the application version.
regression_guards: A live Queue job is never hidden until Queue absence is verified.
Terminal-history proof is accepted only for Failed/Completed/Cancelled SAB history state.
History cleanup remains secondary and best-effort after transfer absence is proven.
No transient-pause bridge is allowed when NewzDeck state says the user intentionally paused the queue.
No old snapshot is bridged after a long idle/restart; a recently proven Active snapshot is required.
The transient-pause bridge expires after 12 seconds so real SAB/disk/provider problems remain visible.
v3.6.15 Wanted-state reconciliation, QUEUEING handoff state, cycle progress, bounded automatic NZB retrieval, and maintenance decoupling remain preserved.
v3.6.14 Windows-safe Automation JSON persistence and responsive monitoring Save behavior remain preserved.
